members.name: routing_A
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which specific issue is the customer asking about? Pick the closest match.

criteria.unrecognised_card_payment: A charge, purchase or deduction appears on the account that the customer did not authorise or does not recognise, or money is missing from the account without explanation. This applies even when the customer only asks why it is there or how to challenge it, and does not use the word fraud. Not a small added amount or fee on the statement that the customer thinks was charged in error.
criteria.unrecognised_cash_withdrawal: A cash or ATM withdrawal is listed in the app that the customer says they did not make, do not recognise, or never received.
criteria.unrecognised_direct_debit: A direct debit or standing payment the customer did not set up or does not recognise.
criteria.card_compromised: The customer suspects their card, card details or PIN have become known to, copied by or used by someone else.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The customer no longer has their card because it went missing or a thief took it, and wants to report or block it, or asks what happens (including fees or charges) in that situation. Not when the card has been found again.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The customer does not have the phone with the banking app on it (lost, stolen, or left somewhere) and asks about access to or safety of the account.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: The customer cannot log in to the app because they forgot or are entering a wrong passcode.
criteria.pin_blocked: The card PIN is rejected, not accepted, blocked or locked, or the customer cannot get past the PIN to use their card.
criteria.request_refund: The customer wants a refund from a merchant or asks how to get money back for a purchase.
criteria.refund_not_received: A refund that was promised by a merchant has not appeared on the account.
criteria.charged_twice: The same payment was charged twice or more.
criteria.statement_extra_charge: A small unexplained amount (typically a round amount of about one unit of currency) or an unexplained fee appears on the statement or in the app, and the customer asks what it is or says it was charged in error. Applies even if it is still pending and even if the customer says they bought nothing for that amount. Not tied to a specific service such as a card payment, transfer, withdrawal or exchange, not fees from using the account abroad or in another currency, and not a whole purchase or withdrawal of ordinary size that they never made.
criteria.fee_policy_complaint: The customer argues with the bank's fee rules: says that a fee the bank applies should not apply to them at all, or complains about the bank's fees in general (new fees introduced on their account, being charged for using the bank's services, how much the bank charges). Not a question asking what an unexplained extra amount or charge on the statement or app is.
criteria.card_payment_reverted: The customer reports that a card payment they made has been cancelled, reversed or returned to the account afterwards and asks what happened. Reported after the fact, not a refusal at the moment of paying.
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: An ATM gave less cash than requested, the wrong amount, or none of the cash the customer asked for, while the account was debited.
criteria.dispute_transaction: The customer asks about the general process for disputing a transaction they did make, such as a purchase that went wrong; not a charge they never authorised.
criteria.apple_google_pay: Using Apple Pay, Google Pay or other phone wallets with the bank, including whether they can be used to top up or add money.
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs can be used, ATM locations or ATM functions.
criteria.card_expiring: The card is about to expire or has expired and needs renewing.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted (shops, countries, merchants).
criteria.card_not_arrived: A card that was ordered has not arrived yet; tracking card delivery.
criteria.card_delivery_time: How long card delivery takes or when or where it can be delivered.
criteria.link_card_in_app: Adding, linking or showing an existing card in the app, including re-enabling a card the customer had misplaced and has now found again.
criteria.card_not_working: The card is not working at all or is broken or damaged.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept or swallowed the card.
criteria.contactless_not_working: Contactless payment with the card does not work.
criteria.card_payment_declined: The card was refused or rejected at the moment of paying in a shop or online. Not a payment the customer says was cancelled afterwards.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_declined: The card was declined when trying to withdraw cash from an ATM.
criteria.change_pin: Changing or setting the card PIN, or where and how a PIN can be changed. Not a PIN that is being rejected or is blocked.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits on how often or how many disposable virtual cards can be used.
criteria.get_disposable_card: Getting or creating a disposable (single-use) virtual card.
criteria.get_virtual_card: Getting or accessing a virtual card.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card is not working or was rejected.
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a physical plastic card, a replacement card or getting a PIN for it.
criteria.spare_card: Getting an additional, second or spare card.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Questions about the Visa or Mastercard networks: whether the bank offers, accepts or lets the customer use one or the other, or both. Treat these as questions about which network the bank's own card is on. Also choosing which kind of card the customer will get.
criteria.transfer_not_arrived_in_balance: An incoming bank transfer has not shown up in the balance.
criteria.deposit_not_in_balance: A cash or cheque deposit has not shown up in the balance.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: A transfer to a payee or beneficiary is not allowed or fails because of the beneficiary.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Cancelling or reversing a bank transfer or payment the customer sent, including one sent to the wrong account.
criteria.cancel_purchase_order: Cancelling an order or purchase made with a merchant, so that the money comes back.
criteria.transfer_declined_or_failed: An outgoing transfer was declined, failed or did not go through.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment (in a shop, at a petrol station, online) is still pending, stuck or taking a long time to complete.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal from an ATM is still showing as pending, or the withdrawn cash is not yet reflected in the balance.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer is still pending or taking a long time.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: The person the customer sent money to says they have not received it.
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money, salary or payments from other people into the account, including which currencies incoming payments or salary can arrive in. Not questions about fees or deductions on incoming money.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to move money into the account from another bank account; types of transfers supported.
criteria.top_up_how: The steps or methods for adding money (topping up) to the account by card, cash, cheque or other means, or how to pay for a transfer the customer wants to send, including whether a card can be used to send money. Not which other cards, card brands or currencies are accepted for topping up.
criteria.auto_top_up: Automatic top-ups when the balance is low.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on how much or how often the account can be topped up.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed, was declined or did not work.
criteria.top_up_pending: A top-up is still pending or the topped-up money has not appeared.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was cancelled, reverted or returned.
criteria.top_up_verification: Verifying a top-up with a code or why a top-up needs verification.
criteria.card_payment_fee: A fee was charged on a card payment.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_fee: A fee was charged for withdrawing cash.
criteria.transfer_fee: A fee was charged for a transfer, what transfers cost, or a transfer arrived with less money than was sent because something was deducted on the way.
criteria.other_fee_question: Whether the bank charges anything, or deducts anything, for an activity not covered by the other fee options, such as receiving money, or whether the full amount of incoming money will arrive without deductions.
criteria.top_up_fee: A fee for topping up by card or bank transfer.
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rates the bank uses, or how they are set.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate: The exchange rate applied to a payment or cash withdrawal abroad was wrong or worse than expected.
criteria.exchange_fee: Fees or charges for exchanging currency.
criteria.exchange_in_app: How to exchange or convert currencies in the app.
criteria.supported_currencies: Which currencies can be held in the account or exchanged in the app (not about receiving incoming payments).
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open or use an account.
criteria.country_support: Whether the bank's account or cards are available to people living in a particular country or region, including signing up or getting a card while living abroad.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details such as name, address or phone.
criteria.verify_identity: How to verify identity or what documents are needed.
criteria.identity_verification_failed: Identity verification is failing or the app cannot verify the customer.
criteria.source_of_funds: Proving or verifying the source of the customer's funds.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Whether other cards (a credit card, a card from another provider, a brand other than the two main networks) or a given currency can be used or are accepted to add money (top up) to the account, or what the bank supports for top-ups. Not about the Visa/Mastercard network of the bank's own card, and not about how to send a transfer.
criteria.transaction_record: The customer wants confirmation, proof, a receipt or details for a payment or transfer they made.
criteria.foreign_use_fee: The customer noticed fees they did not expect after using the account or card abroad, while travelling or in another currency, and asks why.

visa_or_mastercard.request: Questions about the Visa or Mastercard networks: whether the bank offers, accepts or lets the customer use one or the other, or both. Treat these as questions about which network the bank's own card is on. Also choosing which kind of card the customer will get.

wrong_cash_amount.request: An ATM gave less cash than requested, the wrong amount, or none of the cash the customer asked for, while the account was debited.

wrong_exchange_rate.request: The exchange rate applied to a payment or cash withdrawal abroad was wrong or worse than expected.
